#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Interactive RoboLab episode controller for banana_in_bowl (rcb-limited/2.2).

Start this once for the live episode, then issue one command per line:
  obs [depth] [seconds]     fetch/save an observation
  ee x y z qw qx qy qz g    one fingertip-centre target
  joint q1 ... q7 g [dt]    one joint target, optional dt
  json ee|joint JSON [dt]   submit a list/array of action rows
  status                    print episode status
  quit                      exit controller (episode continues)
Each action and observation result is saved under /app/output/episode/.
"""
import json, os, sys, time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = "/app/output/episode"
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
with open(os.path.join(OUT, "spec.json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump(spec, f, indent=2)
print("CONNECTED", r.base, flush=True)
print("BUDGET", json.dumps(spec.get("budget", {})), flush=True)
print("ACTIONS", json.dumps(spec.get("action_types", {})), flush=True)
print("CAMERAS", json.dumps(spec.get("default_cameras", [])), flush=True)
print("PROPRIO_LAYOUT", json.dumps(spec.get("proprio_layout", [])), flush=True)

n = 0
def save_result(result, label):
    global n
    n += 1
    path = os.path.join(OUT, f"{n:03d}_{label}")
    result.save(path)
    print("SAVED", path, "DONE", result.meta.get("done"), "REASON", result.meta.get("reason"), flush=True)
    print("META", json.dumps(result.meta, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, 'tolist') else str(x)), flush=True)
    if result.proprio is not None and len(result.proprio):
        print("LAST_PROPRIO", result.proprio[-1].tolist(), flush=True)
    return result

obs = save_result(r.get_obs(video="frames"), "initial")
print("NOW", json.dumps(obs.meta.get("proprio", {}), default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, 'tolist') else str(x)), flush=True)

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line: continue
    try:
        p = line.split()
        cmd = p[0].lower()
        if cmd in ("quit", "exit"):
            print("BYE", flush=True); break
        if cmd == "status":
            print("STATUS", json.dumps(r.status()), flush=True); continue
        if cmd == "obs":
            dep = "last" if len(p) > 1 and p[1].lower() == "depth" else None
            sec = float(p[2]) if len(p) > 2 else (float(p[1]) if len(p) > 1 and p[1].lower() != "depth" else 0.0)
            result = r.get_obs(seconds=sec, video="frames", depth=dep)
            save_result(result, "obs")
            print("NOW", json.dumps(result.meta.get("proprio", {}), default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, 'tolist') else str(x)), flush=True)
            if result.last_depth:
                for cam, d in result.last_depth.items():
                    nz = d[d > 0]
                    print("DEPTH", cam, "shape", d.shape, "valid", int(nz.size), "minmax", (float(nz.min()), float(nz.max())) if nz.size else None, flush=True)
            continue
        if cmd == "ee":
            vals = [float(x) for x in p[1:]]
            if len(vals) != 8: raise ValueError("ee needs 8 numbers: x y z qw qx qy qz g")
            result = r.submit("ee_pose", np.array(vals, dtype=np.float32), video="both", video_fps=10)
            save_result(result, "ee")
            continue
        if cmd == "joint":
            vals = [float(x) for x in p[1:]]
            dt = vals.pop() if len(vals) == 9 else 1.0 / 15.0
            if len(vals) != 8: raise ValueError("joint needs q1..q7 gripper [dt]")
            result = r.submit("joint_position", np.array(vals, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, video="both", video_fps=10)
            save_result(result, "joint")
            continue
        if cmd == "json":
            atype = p[1]
            rows = json.loads(line[line.index(atype) + len(atype):].strip())
            dt = None
            if isinstance(rows, dict):
                dt = rows.get("dt"); rows = rows["actions"]

            continue
        raise ValueError("unknown command")
    except Exception as e:
